This landmark concert follows the hugely successful release of his latest album, Dynasty, which has seen Ferre Gola sell out major arenas across Africa and Europe.     Daniel Sloss: Bitter

    6:00 PM · OVO Arena Wembley, Wembley Park Para salir

    Please be advised that Wembley Arena seating is divided into bays: - Blocks A and B are not raked and other customers may stand during the performance. - Blocks C and D are tiered behind these. - Block E represents the East Terrace.
